name: DSH-Android
tagline: Run DeepSeek AI agent on Android to control apps, files, and system settings
description: DSH-Android is an Android application that embeds the DeepSeek Harness engine, allowing a language model to operate other apps, manage files, modify system settings, and automate tasks on the phone. Users can issue voice or text commands to send messages, summarize chats, scrape content, place orders, and more. The app works without root or Termux, uses accessibility services for screen interaction, and supports optional Shizuku for deeper system control. It also provides a Linux environment for running Python scripts and can connect to remote computers via SSH. The tool targets users who want AI-driven automation directly on their Android device.
best_for: managing files and system settings on Android
running Python scripts locally on the device
triggering actions based on Wi‑Fi, Bluetooth, or location
